subject: expression: remove providing `EnableVectorizedExpression` in `EvalContext` (#51567)
summary: This commit threads the vectorization enable flag (`EnableVectorizedExpression`) explicitly as a `vecEnabled bool` parameter through key expression evaluation helpers (`EvalExpr`, `VecEvalBool`, `VectorizedFilter*`, `EvaluatorSuite.Run`) and updates executor/planner call sites to pass `ctx.GetSessionVars().EnableVectorizedExpression`. Behavior remains gated by the same session variable; the change is primarily API/parameter plumbing (plus `VecGroupChecker` storing the flag) with no identified correctness/SQL-semantics/concurrency regressions at Blocker/High severity. Upstream `master` retains the same API shape, with no indication of a follow-up fix for a regression introduced here.
